expected_changes: Adds 6 GL accounts "1090 Cash in Transit - Stripe Clearing", one each for Waterview, Lakes of Pine Forest, Canyon Gate, Eaglewood, Quail Ridge and Still Creek (same fund as each 1000).
Adds 18 account-role rows for those six: operating_cash = 1000, stripe_clearing = 1090, homeowner_ar = 1300.
Creates tables stripe_events (empty) and community_account_roles (the 18 roles).

Adds nullable payment identity / settlement / posting columns to payments (the existing 10 rows keep NULLs), reverses_txn_id to homeowner_transactions, tenure_id to assessment_autopay, payment_sandbox (default false) to properties.
Adds payment_reversal and chargeback to the ledger category list (superset); redefines the 461 closing payoff to skip reversal rows (otherwise identical).
Adds 16 functions, 3 triggers (account-role guard, sandbox guard, autopay cancel on sale), 11 indexes plus 2 primary keys.
Creates NO payment, homeowner ledger row, journal entry, Stripe event, autopay enrollment or sandbox data.
